resources.string: Press submit if you are done to update plant progress

Theragarden is a mobile wellness app designed to help users manage stress, track their emotions, and cultivate healthier habits through gamified plant growth. Every action you take - logging your mood, completing self-care exercises, or writing a journal entry - helps your virtual plant growth, symbolizing your personal progress and consistency.\n \nOur mission is to make mental health care more accessible, private, and rewarding. By combining therapy-inspired techniques, mindful journaling, and motivational visuals, Theragarden turns emotional awareness into a creative, uplifting experience.

Welcome to Theragarden 
 Track your moods, care for yourself, and watch your virtual plants bloom as you grow too 

Your Garden
 When your first plant fully blooms, you'll unlock your virtual garden to showcase your progress 

Mood Check-In
 Start or end your dat with a quick mood check. Pick an emoji that matches how you feel and add a short note. Track your emotions over time to see your patterns and progress.

Self-Care Hub
Access relaxing and creative activities anytime.

Stats
View your wellness journey in one place. Track mood, sleep, hydration, and activity streaks.

Rewards and Customization
 Earn rewards as you complete activities! Unlock seed packs, grow new plants, and decorate your garden with special themes 

About Page
 Access professional mental-health resources and crisis hotline anytime. All links are confidential and always available.
